description:
Returns who is signed in and every company they can open, with their role in each. This is the first call a client makes after sign-in: almost every other call needs a company id from companies[].id.

Any signed-in person may call it. It also does housekeeping on the way: it makes sure the person's personal company exists and turns any email invitations waiting for them into memberships, so a company someone was just added to shows up here.

The x-company-id header is optional here. currentCompanyId tells you which company the server will use for requests that send this header; with no header, or one naming a company the person is not in, it falls back to their personal company instead of failing.

Other fields: companyLimit is how many companies a person may create (null means no limit) and companiesCreated is how many they have created so far, for a "New company" button. onboardedAt on each company is null until its setup is finished. paused on each company lists what a Liliphant admin has stopped there because it costs money (recording, processing, ask, automations); empty means nothing is, and ask means AI answers are refused, so a screen can say so instead of offering them. operator is true for the people who may open the admin panel. logoUrl and brandColor appear on a company whose profile has a website that Things of Brand knows; both are left out otherwise. hasMeetings is true once the current company has at least one meeting (one still being processed counts); until then the app shows only the first-meeting screen and Settings.

Errors: 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN when no token is sent; 401 SESSION_EXPIRED when the token is no longer valid. GET https://meet-analyzer-api.50agents.com/api/v1/ui/me
name: get_me
